instruction: Work in AutoCAD and open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\cast_part.dxf. Import cast_part.dxf. Draw a cast bracket outline rectangle (0,0)-(170,90), two circular bosses radius 18 at (45,45) and (125,45), three rib CENTER lines from (45,45) to (85,75), (45,45) to (85,15), and (125,45) to (85,45), plus text ACAD-36. Use OUTLINE for the cast bracket rectangle and bosses, CENTER for rib lines, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
